svg.title: claude-remote-mcp architecture
svg.desc: Three layers and four trust boundaries. Interaction: the Claude app (voice, mobile, CarPlay, web, desktop). It reaches the orchestration layer on the gateway host over MCP over HTTPS through a Cloudflare Tunnel with an OAuth access token: mcp-gateway handles OAuth, authentication, tool routing, agent operations and enrollment, and keeps clients and token hashes in oauth.json, its agent hosts in bridges.json and the enrollment window in enrollment.json. mcp-gateway reaches the execution layer over HTTP on the LAN with each host's bearer token, and agent hosts enroll with the gateway over the LAN with the window's secret. There are three agent hosts: macOS, Linux and Windows. On each, agent-bridge runs as a launchd service, a systemd user unit or a scheduled task and keeps its id and gateway in state.json and the agents to restore after herdr restarts in agents.json; only agents under its allowed roots can be changed. It drives herdr workspaces and panes through the herdr CLI, and herdr runs Claude Code sessions, one per pane, each on the Claude account set up for its folder, with ids that name the host, such as mac/w1:p1.
